app.name: AmberBeam
app.tagline: Dual-pane FTP and SFTP client for macOS, Windows and Linux — built for people who miss FlashFXP.
status.explain: This window transfers nothing yet. It exists to prove the toolchain and to show that the three seams are in place before any work is built on top of them.
seams.title: The three seams
seams.intro: Each of them would be a rebuild of the foundation if it were added later, so all three stand from the first commit.
seam.endpoints.title: Source and target are endpoints
seam.endpoints.body: The transfer engine knows two arbitrary endpoints and never assumes that one side is the local machine. Server to server, and later FXP, are additional cases instead of a rebuild.
seam.bridge.title: One door to the core
seam.bridge.body: The user interface never calls Tauri. Every access goes through a bridge module with two implementations: Tauri's channel, and HTTP plus WebSocket for the container build.
seam.i18n.title: No text in the code
seam.i18n.body: Every string on this page comes from a language file. Switching below does not reload anything — it only changes which file is read.
